cases.sentence: У входа в городские ворота было четверо ___.
cases.translation: There were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the number четверо (four) when counting persons.

cases.sentence: Они вышли и пошли в лагерь к ___.
cases.translation: They went to the Syrian camp.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Они наелись, напились и унесли оттуда ___, золото и одежды.
cases.translation: They ate and drank, and carried away silver, gold, and clothing.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the verb 'унесли' (carried away).
The instrumental case is used after the verb 'спаслись' (saved themselves).

cases.sentence: Вся дорога была усеяна одеждами, которые бросали во время стремительного ___.
cases.translation: The entire path was full of garments which the Syrians cast away in their haste.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the preposition 'во время' (during).

cases.sentence: Царь встал ночью и сказал своим ___, что произошло.
cases.translation: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants what the Syrians had done.
cases.explain: The dative case is used after the verb 'сказал' (said to).

cases.sentence: Они ехали по следам войска до самого ___ и видели одежды.
cases.translation: They traveled on the trail of the Syrian army all the way to the Jordan.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with the preposition 'до' (as far as).

cases.translation: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used for the direct object of the verb 'разграбил' (plundered).

reading.ru: Сановник, на чью руку опирался царь Израиля, сказал Божьему человеку, «Послушай, этого не может быть, даже если Господь откроет небесные окна».
reading.question: What did the king's officer say to Elisha about his prophecy?
options: He said it could not be, even if the Lord opened the windows of heaven
reading.correct: He said it could not be, even if the Lord opened the windows of heaven
reading.explain: The officer said 'этого не может быть, даже если Господь откроет небесные окна' — this cannot be, even if the Lord opened heaven's windows.

reading.ru: Чего нам сидеть тут и ждать смерти? Если мы решим, пойдем в город, то там голод, и мы умрем.
reading.question: What reasoning did the lepers use to decide to go to the Syrian camp?
options: They wanted to help the city
They reasoned that sitting there would lead to death, and going to the city would also lead to death from hunger
They thought the Syrians would protect them
reading.correct: They reasoned that sitting there would lead to death, and going to the city would also lead to death from hunger
reading.explain: The lepers discussed that staying or going to the city would both result in death, so they decided to go to the Syrian camp.

reading.ru: Когда они добрались до края лагеря, там никого не было, потому что владыка сделал так, что армии услышали шум колесниц, коней и огромного войска.
reading.question: Why did the Syrian army leave their camp?
options: They heard sounds of chariots, horses, and a great army (which the Lord had made them hear)
reading.correct: They heard sounds of chariots, horses, and a great army (which the Lord had made them hear)
reading.explain: The text says the Lord made the Syrian army hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, causing them to flee.

reading.ru: Они сказали друг другу, Мы поступаем неправильно. Это день хороших вестей, а мы держим их при себе.
reading.question: What did the lepers decide to do after realizing they were keeping the good news to themselves?
options: They decided to go and tell the king's household about the empty camp
They left the camp to search for more treasure
reading.correct: They decided to go and tell the king's household about the empty camp
reading.explain: The lepers realized 'Это день хороших вестей, а мы держим их при себе' — today is a day of good news and they must share it.

reading.ru: Сату лучшей муки стали продавать за шекель, и две саты ячменя за шекель, как и сказал Господь.
reading.question: What happened to the prices of grain after the people plundered the Syrian camp?
options: A measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel and two measures of barley for a shekel, as the Lord had said
reading.correct: A measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel and two measures of barley for a shekel, as the Lord had said
reading.explain: The text states that prices were exactly as Elisha had prophesied.

reading.ru: Ты увидишь это своими глазами, но есть не будешь.
reading.question: What did Elisha predict would happen to the skeptical officer?
options: He would eat the most of the grain
He would see the abundant grain with his own eyes, but would not eat of it
reading.correct: He would see the abundant grain with his own eyes, but would not eat of it
reading.explain: Elisha told the officer 'Ты увидишь это своими глазами, но есть не будешь' — You will see it with your eyes but will not eat of it.
